nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored in Owned.owner, set in the constructor.
Last block number recorded by Play, used as weak anti-mining protection.
Constant magic = 5, used as divisor for house edge and payout.
Constructor that assigns msg.sender to owner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing body.
View function returning address(this).balance.
onlyOwner function that selfdestructs sending balance to msg.sender.
View function returning getBalance()/magic.
Payable game entry: checks bet limit, uses block.timestamp randomness, pays out and stores block.number.
Modifier requiring tx.origin == msg.sender (anti-bot / phishing-prone guard).
Modifier requiring block.number != last_blocknumber to block same-block mining.
Payable fallback function that forwards to Play().
Caller-controlled address, used as owner, recipient of funds and in guards.
now, used as pseudo-randomness source in Play (now % magic).
Transaction origin, used in protect modifier and vulnerable to phishing.
Selfdestruct sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender in close().
External value transfer to caller computed from msg.value and dynamic balance checks.
Authorization based on tx.origin, bypassable via phishing/intermediary contracts.
Branch conditioned on block.timestamp modulo, miner-influenceable pseudo-randomness.
Payout arithmetic performed before the external transfer, funds-conservation risk.
Ownership check inside onlyOwner modifier.
Block-number based guard in protect_mining, weak against miner manipulation.
Bet limit check comparing caller value against balance-derived maximum.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the constructor.
msg.sender is compared to owner in the onlyOwner require.
owner state variable is read inside the onlyOwner require.
tx.origin is trusted for authorization in protect, enabling phishing bypass.
msg.sender is compared against tx.origin in protect.
protect modifier body contains the tx.origin check.
block.timestamp (now) drives the modulo condition, miner-manipulable randomness.
magic constant used as modulo operand in Play.
magic divides the balance in getMaxBet.
getMaxBet calls getBalance to read the contract balance.
Play queries getMaxBet to bound msg.value.
Play enforces msg.value <= getMaxBet() before paying out.
Play branches on the timestamp-derived modulo condition.
Play performs an external value transfer to the caller.
Transfer recipient is the untrusted msg.sender, a potential reentrant contract.
Payout arithmetic feeds the external transfer amount.
Play reads block.timestamp for its randomness check.
Fallback function forwards all plain transfers to Play().
protect modifier is applied to Play.
protect_mining modifier is applied to Play.
last_blocknumber state variable is read by the protect_mining require.
protect_mining modifier holds the block-number comparison.
Play writes block.number into last_blocknumber.
close calls selfdestruct, destroying the contract and forwarding balance.
selfdestruct beneficiary is msg.sender, an untrusted address.
onlyOwner modifier guards close.
onlyOwner modifier body contains the owner require check.
External value transfer to msg.sender can invoke the recipient's fallback, re-entering Play.
